items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Clyde Hart was your regular piano player, right. I think Jimmy Butts, bass player. Clyde was off and on. Clyde was there -- low key -- quiet like me... Also Clyde Hart at one time or another.

ctx.x: reissued the thing and put Coleman Hawkins 364. name [as leader].
Did you play as a sideman at all after you left Art Tatum, on 52nd Street?

Once. I wasn't a sideman, I was a co-leader with a guy named Teddy Briggs -- Riggs -- Teddy Briggs? ... He was a saxophone player and he knew I worked down there a lot and he got a gig and he offered me partnership to share and get the guys playin' behind him. I think his name was Ted.
